book.title: APALYNAH JOHAN TEI A HMUHPAW APALYNAH BIA

content: Sardi khua khrisawbu letei cakuapaw

“Sardi khua letei khrisawbu vaiming hai letaco, ma hrahei cia my lo. Khazing thlawpaw sangsarih le esi sangsarih a hnuipaw takhei ma hrahei bia a rei. Na hming tuapaw vytei ka hni, a thi ciapaw na cang naná tah ahringpaw na lo.
A hrah la, na hnui ciapaw hming, a thi daimangpaw khah a thaw patlung kaw tua. Na hming tuapaw vytei heh ka Khazing meh letah a tlingpaw ung be.
Macawtaco naa hmuh ciapaw le naa thui ciapaw khah a cingkai la, ma khah zui la a ngepachih my lo. Na hraw ly caco mehru hratah a vong neh ka, ze cai letah maw ka vong a tahpaw khah hnih bei ceh.

Canghrasala Sardi khua lekhei a buhpaw he pai a papia a palui lypaw cawngsaw a cawngtei a ung he. Aaning sahlo cawh pai rangpaw a buá tah kama khatah a cinglai hra he. Zemaw tah pawco aaning cawh ma hratei a tua tlangpaw a cang he.

A tetupaw maikaw cawh ma hraco pai rangpaw a buh sá tah ung he ka, mataico hringnah cabu chung taico aa ming cawh thehly bei neh. Ka Paw hme le a vaiming sahlo hme leco aa ming cawh ka cang khui hri he a.
Thlawpaw tei khrisawbu sahlo hai letei bia a reipaw heh thuinah nawkho a hnuipaw maikaw taco thui he seh,” tatah a tah.
Filadelfia khua khrisawbu letei cakuapaw

“Filadelfia khua letei khrisawbu vaiming hai letaco ma hrahei cia my lo. Siangpahrang David cabi a hnuipaw, mehpathai le mehding a cangpaw takhei ma hrahei bia a rei. Ama tei a hongpaw ingkaw cawh ahotahmai kha khy be ca ka, Ama tei a khapaw ingkaw cawh ahotahmai hong khy be.
Na hming tuapaw vytei ka hni. Thawtlungnah a cawngtei hnui ceh ka, ma hmo co ka bia khah a cingkai ceh ka, ka ming zong a paphah sai be ca ceh ka, ahotahmai kha khy lypaw ingkaw na hme letah ka hong.

Nawthlia tua, Setan caw tei synagog letei a pungpaw he, Juda cawngsaw hmuisang cangnah hnui tlung ly tei hingbia rei tei Juda cawngsaw ka cang peh a tahpaw sahlo he cawh taw he neh ka, na hme letah aa khuh ka panaisah he a. Ka ca do hmuisui tahpaw khah ka hnisah he a.
Lungsy teitah mua ing pawtah naw ka ca pehpaw na tlethlangnah cawtah alui letei a ungpaw mehnung vytei pase rua pawtei ma khazaw letei a va tlung lepaw pasenah chung taico ka ca bingsá a.
Ka vong pating a. Ahotahmai na suilukhu khah aa ca lah pah ly nápawtah na hnui ciapaw khah achaw teitah a tle thlang my lo.

A tetupaw maikaw cawh ka Khazing behnah ing leco asuh tung tah ka tua he a. Ma taiteipaw cawh piathlah khaw bei he. Ka Khazingpaw ming, ka Khazingpaw khuapui ming, Jerusalem thapaw, ka Khazingpaw taitah vaicung taitei a za cung lepaw le ka ming thapaw khatah aa cung letah ka cia a.
Thlawpaw tei khrisawbu sahlo hai letei bia a reipaw heh thuinah nawkho a hnuipaw maikaw taco thui he seh,” tatah a tah.
Laodisia khua khrisawbu letei cakuapaw

“Laodisia khua letei khrisawbu vaiming hai letaco ma hrahei cia my lo. Amen a cangpaw bia hnihtu hmuisui le zingchuipaw le mehding a cangpaw, Khazing hming tuapaw a hrangthonah taco, ma hrahei bia a rei.
Na hming tuapaw vytei ka hni, cakaw tlung ly, lung tlung ly tei na cangpaw heh. Na lung caco lung lalo la, na cakaw caco cakaw lalo tahpaw ka du.
Ma hratei lung tlung ly, cakaw tlung ly, lungpipu tah na cangnah cawtah ka kaw taitah ka ca chothlang a.
Ka dawng a chah, ka hnuirung, zehmai a phahlah bei neh na tah, a cang naná tah nama cawh mehsisah, ningdo chuipaw, mehdongchia, mehco, thlekalong tah na cangpaw khah na hnilynah cawtah a cang.

Na dawng a chah khy nápawtah me tei ro pase ciapaw sui le na thlekalong muaphynah cawh a lang ly nápawtah pai rang le, na meh khua a hmuh khy nápawtah na meh letei na hne ruapaw mehsi zong kama taitah co la, tahpaw rawhnah ka ca peh.
Ka dopaw maikaw cawh cawngpah he neh ka, ka chingrei tei he. Macawtaco chahnai nge la, a ngepachih my lo.
Naw thlia tua, ingkaw thahrang letah a daw neh ka, ingkaw ka khong hi. Ahotahmai ka o thui ka, ingkaw a pa hongpaw maikaw cawh ama kha a nae neh ka, batui kaa e hrui a.
A tetupaw maikaw cawh kama zong tah te neh katei, ka Paw khatah abui dyching letah ka typaw hratah ka buidyching letah kama khatah a ty hra he a.
Thlawpaw tei khrisawbu sahlo hai letei bia a reipaw heh thuinah nawkho a hnuipaw maikaw taco thui he seh,” tatah a tah.
